name: Veesing
author: veesing

sections.description:
EN
Veesing allows WordPress sites to easily add SMS verification and image captcha to user registration forms.
It helps prevent spam registration and supports domestic and international SMS sending via the Veesing API.

中文说明
Veesing 插件支持在 WordPress 默认注册表单中添加手机号输入、短信验证码发送与图形验证码校验。
支持国内外短信发送、模板配置和接口密钥设置，可在后台直接配置中昱维信短信服务。

Features

  • Add phone number field to default WordPress registration form.
  • Integrate SMS verification via Veesing API.
  • Include image captcha for anti-spam protection.
  • Support domestic and international SMS.
  • Admin setting page for API credentials and template IDs.
  • 中文后台设置界面，便于国内用户配置。

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API service provided by Veesing to send and verify SMS/MMS verification codes.

Service used:
– Veesing SMS Verification API — used to deliver one-time passwords (OTP) and template-based SMS/MMS messages.

What data is sent and when:
– Recipient mobile phone number (sent only when an SMS/MMS is requested)
– Verification code and template variables (sent at time of request)
– Plugin credentials (appId, appKey, templateId) used for authentication

Where data is sent:
– https://vip.veesing.com/smsApi/verifyCode

Links:
– Terms of Service: https://www.veesing.com/terms.html
– Privacy Policy: https://www.veesing.com/privacy.html
sections.installation:
EN
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/veesing directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
3. Go to Settings → Veesing SMS to configure your API account and template ID.
4. Visit /wp-login.php?action=register to test SMS verification and captcha.

中文安装说明
1. 将插件文件上传到 /wp-content/plugins/veesing 目录，或在插件后台直接安装。
2. 在 WordPress 后台启用插件。
3. 进入 设置 → Veesing SMS 配置 API 账号和模板 ID。
4. 访问 /wp-login.php?action=register 测试短信验证码和图形验证码。
sections.faq:
EN

Does it support WooCommerce?

Currently supports default registration form only. WooCommerce support is planned for future versions.

Can I use my own SMS provider?

This plugin is specifically built for the Veesing SMS API.

中文 FAQ

是否支持 WooCommerce？

目前仅支持默认注册表单，未来版本计划支持 WooCommerce。

可以使用自己的短信服务商吗？

本插件专为 Veesing 短信 API 设计。
